1. (Currently Amended) A compound of formula (IIa) O NaO OR2 O (IIa), in which substituent R2 is selected from the group consisting of alkyl, aryl, and arylalkyl, __wherein R2 is not ethyl__.

2. (Currently Amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (IIa) in which R2 is C1-C12-alkyl, C6-aryl, or arylalkyl, __wherein R2 is not ethyl__.

3. (Original) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (IIa) in which R2 is methyl or ethyl.

4. (Currently Amended) A compound of formula (IIb) O ZO OMe O O (IIb) in which substituent Z is selected from the group consisting of alkali metals and alkaline earth metals, __wherein Z is not potassium__.

5. (Currently Amended) A compound according to Claim 4 of formula (IIb) in which Z is sodium or potassium, __wherein the compound is not the potassium salt__.
